full_depth_grammar.whole_first: the wave-1 corpus-root journey sp-aikit remains the whole (S2's movement path); full-depth journeys bind the remaining inventoried records and never duplicate the movement path
full_depth_grammar.journey_unit: one oi.journey per inventory family (the census's own directory grouping), at most 12 scenes per journey; larger families split into sequential parts
full_depth_grammar.scene_unit: one scene per bound record: ground disc + up to four term glyphs drawn from the record's own heading words + one glyph naming the record (6 formations, under the 10-formation runtime limit; 7 entities incl. disc, under the 32-entity schema limit)
full_depth_grammar.text_relation: same margin-column page relation as wave-1 (right side, x 0.78, width 300, size 17; plain text body — shared defect #8)
full_depth_grammar.privacy: every bound record byte-identical to published origin/main at pass time; records drifted on main since the census freeze are bound at current main bytes with the delta named in their binding record; dirty working trees never read
full_depth_grammar.classification: full depth stipulated: every authored census record enters; exclusions (build outputs, lockfiles, generated/derived state, CI templates) are disclosed with reasons in the receipt, never silent
